europe_now.title: Bulgarian PM summons Russian ambassador following drone attack
europe_now.summary: A ship has sunk off the coast of Bulgaria following a new drone attack in the region. In response to the incident, the Bulgarian prime minister has summoned the Russian ambassador.

sources.headline: Ship sinks in new drone attack off Bulgaria, PM summons Russian ambassador

europe_now.title: UK summons Iranian ambassador over RAF Fairford security incident
europe_now.summary: The British government has summoned the Iranian ambassador following an investigation into a security incident at the RAF Fairford base. While Tehran has denied any involvement, UK officials state it is highly likely that Iran was behind the breach.

sources.headline: Tehran denies involvement in UK Fairford air base incident as Britain summons Iranian ambassador
UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident

top_stories.title: French student protests and nationwide rallies
top_stories.summary: France is preparing for fresh nationwide student demonstrations concerning school conditions. Climate activist Greta Thunberg has joined the student protests ahead of broader planned rallies.

sources.headline: France braces for fresh nationwide student demonstrations
🔴 Live: Greta Thunberg joins French student protests ahead of nationwide rallies

top_stories.title: Spanish poll reflects security anxieties over Ceuta
top_stories.summary: Recent polling in Spain indicates that public concern is rising regarding the regional situation involving Ceuta. Some survey respondents have expressed fears that the ongoing crisis could potentially escalate into armed conflict with Morocco.

sources.headline: Poll: Spaniards say Ceuta crisis could spark armed conflict with Morocco
